summary: The main article describes a silver/chiral PPY relay catalytic system for the synthesis of bispirocyclopentenes. It includes 8 figures and 1 table detailing optimization, substrate scope, mechanistic studies, and biological evaluation of the products as PDE1B inhibitors.

items.heading: Fig. 1
items.caption: Metal/chiral 4-aminopyridine dual catalytic system and its application in cycloisomerization/(2 + 3) cycloaddition cascade reactions of enynamides. A Known and undeveloped metal/organic Lewis base dual catalytic systems. B Cascade cycloisomerization/cyclization of yne-enone and enynamide. C This work: silver/PPY-catalyzed cycloisomerization/(2 + 3) cycloaddition.
items.description: Overview of dual catalytic systems and the specific relay catalysis developed in this work for enynamide cycloisomerization.

items.heading: Fig. 2
items.caption: Representative bioactive spiro-pyrazolones and pyrazolecontaining PDE1 inhibitors. A Pharmacologically important spiropyrazolone scaffolds with druggability. B Representative PDE1 inhibitors containing pyrazole pharmacophores.
items.description: Displays various bioactive molecules and known PDE1 inhibitors that share structural features with the synthesized products.

items.heading: Table 1
items.caption: Optimization of the reaction conditions.
items.description: This table (text-based in the source) summarizes the screening of catalysts, additives, and temperatures to optimize the yield and enantioselectivity of product 3a.

items.heading: Fig. 3
items.caption: Substrate scope of the MBH carbonates and enynamides a . a Conditions: 1 (0.1 mmol) and AgOAc (10 mol%) in CHCl3 (1.0 mL) was stirred at 40 °C for 1 h. Then, 2 (0.1 mmol) and C9 (20 mol%) were added, and the reaction was stirred at 0 °C for 48 h and at 40 °C for another 3 h.
items.description: Shows the chemical structures and yields/enantioselectivities for the library of bispirocyclopentene pyrazolone products synthesized.

items.heading: Fig. 4
items.caption: Scale-up synthesis and transformations of product 3a. A Scale-up synthesis of 3a . B Stereoselective epoxidation. C Stereodivrgent isomerization and site-selective C-H functionalization.
items.description: Demonstrates the practical application of the method through a 1.0 mmol scale reaction and subsequent chemical modifications of the product.

items.heading: Fig. 5
items.caption: Control experiments and computational calculations. A Catalyst effect studies. B DFT-optimized structures and relative free energies ( ∆ G , kcal/ mol) of transition states TS1 and TS2 along two possible chemoselective pathways at the M06/Def2-TZVP-SMD(CHCl3)//M06/6-31 G(d,p)SMD(CHCl3) level.
items.description: Mechanistic investigation including control reactions to identify the role of each catalyst and DFT calculations to explain chemoselectivity.

items.heading: Fig. 6
items.caption: Proposed mechanism for the silver/chiral PPY relay catalytic cycloisomerization/(2 + 3) cycloaddition cascade reaction of enynamide.
items.description: A schematic representation of the catalytic cycle involving silver-catalyzed cycloisomerization and PPY-catalyzed cycloaddition.

items.heading: Fig. 7
items.caption: PDE1 inhibition of product 3. A The inhibitory rate of compounds 3 on PDEIB @0.1 μ mol·L -1 . B In vitro PDE1 inhibition of selective compounds on three PDE1 subtypes. C Relative inhibition of 3x on the PDE family proteins @0.1 μ mol·L -1 . D 3D contour of the binding conformation of 3x and PDE1B. E 2D contour of the binding conformation of 3x and PDE1B. F The RMSD (root-mean-square deviations) of the protein main chain atoms compared to the initial conformer. G Decomposition of the individual component of binding free energies of 3x -PDE1B complex by MM/PBSA.
items.description: Biological data showing the inhibitory activity of the synthesized compounds against PDE1 enzymes and molecular docking simulations.

items.heading: Fig. 8
items.caption: The therapeutic effects and preliminary mechanism of compound 3x. A Western blot analysis of Fibronectin, Collagen-I, α -SMA and GAPDH expression levels. B Immunofluorescence staining analysis for the expression of α -SMA proteins. C Immunofluorescence staining analysis for the expression of Fibronectin. D The bar graph shows the pulmonary respiratory function of different groups of rats. E Representative hematoxylin-eosin (H&E) staining sections and Masson staining sections from the pulmonary tissues.
items.description: In vivo and in vitro evaluation of compound 3x in treating pulmonary fibrosis, including western blots and tissue staining.
